conditions: The publisher issues more than 100 printed copies or copies in media that commonly have printed covers of the Document.
The Document’s authorized license notice requires Cover Texts.
limitations: The claim covers the required text placement in section 3. The same clause also addresses publisher identification and front-cover title presentation.
The Opaque and Transparent copy rule has its own trigger. Determine the work notice and edition before applying either rule.

triggers: GNU corrects the registered edition or issues controlling clarification on a cited clause.
The source representation, work-notice assumptions, or exact scope of this proposition changes.

statement: GNU FDL 1.3 section 3 requires clearly legible required Front-Cover and Back-Cover Texts on the corresponding covers when a publisher issues more than 100 printed copies or copies in media that commonly have printed covers of a covered Document and its license notice requires Cover Texts. The next paragraph gives placement instructions when the required text does not fit legibly on a cover.
